title: Professional Journey
paragraphs: I am a full-stack developer at inquirED.  Currently, I have been working with React and Node.js applications that deliver inquiry-based curriculum to educators and students across the United States.

My work spans a headless CMS, multiple node.js and React applications, and includes management of AWS services and CI/CD workflows to support reliable deployments, performant delivery, and scalable architecture.

I build pixel perfect UIs that are accessible and responsive across desktop and mobile screen sizes. I partner with designers and stakeholders to translate requirements into intuitive and visually appealing interfaces.
